The '''Sanchor III comlink jammer''' was a type of [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] [[Jammer/Legends|jammer]] used by the [[Chosen (Nuso Esva)|Chosen]], the elite [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]] of<ref name="Choices" /> [[Storm-hair]]<ref name="Crisis of Faith">{{StoryCite|story=Crisis of Faith|book=Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition}}</ref> [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] and his [[Nuso Esva's realm|realm]]. The jammer had a boxy shape and was equipped with a huge [[Antenna/Legends|antenna]].<ref name="Choices" />

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="ChoicesD">The events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' take place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]].</ref> during a [[Battle for Poln Major|battle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Poln Major]], the Chosen placed a Sanchor III in the [[Whistling Wind]] [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcafe's]] basement to jam the comlinks of five former [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] that formed the [[Hand of Judgment]] group. After the device was disabled and its Chosen users were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by members of the [[Troukree]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the Hand of Judgment's leader, [[Daric LaRone]], was able to use his comlink to speak with [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]].<ref name="Choices" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sanchor III comlink jammer appeared in the [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]'' by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="Choices" />
